evidence.title: Dembrandt | Extract, Track and Compare Design Systems
Dembrandt App | Extract, Track and Compare Design Tokens

name: Dembrandt
summary: CLI that extracts any live website's design system as W3C design tokens, DESIGN.md, Tailwind and shadcn themes.
description: Dembrandt renders a page with Playwright, reads computed styles from the DOM and returns design tokens: colors with evidence, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and component styles, plus breakpoints, icons and framework detection. Outputs include DTCG JSON, DESIGN.md, Tailwind v4 @theme CSS, shadcn themes, an HTML report and a brand-guide PDF, with WCAG contrast checks and a --compare drift gate for CI. An MCP server exposes the same extractions to Claude Code, Cursor and other AI agents.
contains: extracts colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion, components, breakpoints, icons and frameworks
exports: DTCG tokens, DESIGN.md, Tailwind v4 @theme, shadcn theme, HTML report, brand guide PDF, JSON
analysis flags: WCAG, compare drift gate, tokens check, AI brand-primary prediction
coverage flags: multi-page crawl, sitemap discovery, dark mode, mobile viewport
MCP server (io.github.dembrandt/dembrandt) with extraction and analysis tools
drift tracking app (beta): baselines, snapshots, visual diff, CI uploads
requires Node.js 18+ and a Playwright browser download; MIT licensed
